configuration.probability_method: Binary XGBoost scores normalized within each race; identical to the existing walk-forward champion architecture.

candidate_probability_calibration.definition: Count-weighted absolute gap between mean predicted probability and observed winner frequency across all driver-race candidates.

top_choice_calibration.definition: Count-weighted absolute gap between mean top-driver probability and top-pick hit rate across races.

holdout_policy: The input is restricted to seasons through 2024. 2025 is reserved and is not used for fitting, evaluation, calibration or model selection.
interpretation_warning: Calibration bins are descriptive diagnostics, not a fitted calibrator. Do not fit calibration parameters on these out-of-fold outcomes and then report performance on the same folds.
